answer_1.quote: The proposed PPA consistently achieves the best performance on both evaluation datasets and general benchmarks like AlpacaEval.

answer_2.quote: using the Win Rate of policy models against SFT models as our primary metric.

answer_3.quote: we employ GPT-4 Turbo as the standard judge model to determine which of the two responses exhibits higher quality.

answer_4.quote: we conducted a comprehensive human evaluation involving 20 raters on the Prolific platform. Each rater compared 15 pairs of model outputs, with a total of 300 pairs evaluated across three matchups (PPA vs SFT, PPA vs DPO, PPA vs LiPO).
